scope: Independent automated investigation; no active Windows/Linux desktop input, installation, runtime restart or settings changes

confirmed_defect.trigger: Native document-routing gesture queued while semantic focus A is visible; focus/snapshot/control/handler changes before NVDA executes it
failures: same-ID changed text receives old coordinates
control-generation change does not cancel native route
confirmed_defect.fix: Guard per-gesture executeScript; keep original native script and input pipeline; validate original handler, main buffer, focus snapshot, session/control before recovery and execution

tests.runtime: Selected native NVDA methods with fake display/transport; real isolated Windows kernel pipe/DPAPI/DACL/cancellation tests
NVDA 2026.2 selected source methods, fake display/transport; no installed NVDA execution
